Feast of the Holy Innocents (Childermas Banquet)

Childermas Banquet: Celebrating the Youngest at the Feast of the Holy Innocents

Celebrate the Feast of the Holy Innocents by honoring the youngest family members with a whimsical winter table and a banquet of child-sized delights steeped in tradition.

  1. Morning

    Decorate the Table

    Set a whimsical winter table with white candles, holly berries, and silver bells to create a festive and meaningful atmosphere for the feast.

  2. Midday

    Prepare Baby Bellini Aperitifs

    Mix sparkling wine or apple cider with white peach puree to create refreshing Baby Bellinis, the perfect aperitif to welcome guests and start the celebration.

    Recipes: Baby Bellini

  3. Early Afternoon

    Serve Baby Beet Bisque Starter

    Offer baby beet bisque swirled with crème fraîche and dill over star-cut rye croutons, a comforting and elegant first course to warm the spirit.

    Recipes: Baby Beet Bisque

  4. Mid Afternoon

    Enjoy Baby Greens Salad

    Toss baby greens with baby tomatoes, carrots, and corn in honey-citrus vinaigrette, topped with toasted almonds and edible flowers for a fresh, colorful salad.

    Recipes: Baby Greens Salad

  5. Late Afternoon

    Main Course Feast

    Serve slow-smoked baby back ribs with pomegranate glaze alongside herb-roasted Cornish hens with clementine pan jus, accompanied by duck-fat roasted baby potatoes, baby corn gratin with nutmeg-Parmesan crust, and braised baby onions in balsamic reduction.

    Recipes: Slow-Smoked Baby Back Ribs · Herb-Roasted Cornish Hens · Duck-Fat Roasted Baby Potatoes · Baby Corn Gratin · Braised Baby Onions

  6. Evening

    Fresh Milk Rolls with Honey Butter

    Offer pillowy milk rolls served with whipped honey butter, perfect for savoring alongside the hearty main courses.

    Recipes: Milk Rolls with Whipped Honey Butter

  7. Night

    Sweet Finish and Toast

    Conclude the feast with baby cheesecakes topped in spiced pear-cranberry compote or tableside baby bananas Foster, and raise a toast with Babycham or warm milk punch dusted with nutmeg to honor the day's youngest presiders.

    Recipes: Baby Cheesecakes · Baby Bananas Foster · Babycham Cocktail · Warm Milk Punch

End the day by sharing stories and gratitude around the table, cherishing the joy and innocence of the youngest family members.
